purpose: Original-event industry qualification without altering frozen S/Q or histories
source: Same original accession SEC .hdr.sgml; exact matching FILER / COMPANY-DATA CIK and ASSIGNED-SIC only
parser_rules: One SEC-HEADER and one matching original ACCESSION-NUMBER
Structurally balanced, nonnested FILER and COMPANY-DATA blocks; exactly one COMPANY-DATA per FILER
CIK ASCII1-10digits, positive, normalize to10digits; expected CIK is exact10digits
SIC ASCII1-4digits, normalize to4digits; consistent duplicate numeric fields allowed; any malformed/conflicting duplicate unavailable
Exactly one matching FILER; multiple matching FILER blocks remain ambiguous even if codes agree
Any unidentified or internally ambiguous FILER linkage leaves the header unavailable; other well-identified cofilers never provide the event SIC
No current-profile SIC, tag aliases, text labels, nearest block or first-flat-value fallback
Out-of-range valid code is excluded; absent/malformed/ambiguous/source-unavailable is unavailable
Retain raw source SHA256 and exact original byte spans for header, FILER, COMPANY-DATA and selected CIK/SIC fields
integration: Q.enrich_filing and Q.build_features run unchanged before adding industry_status and strategy_source_status. Preserve every existing field including joint_feature_status, S,Q,u,selected, clocks and eight-prior histories. Industry qualification applies only to current event.
source_terminal_gate: Full collector needs terminal completion, no unresolved STOP, no active source writer, exact ordered100-member request/cohort/registry and verified frozen source implementation/finalization/model identities. Terminal incomplete captures retain discovered original failures plus all100 issuer denominators; incomplete discovery has unknown undiscovered-original count, never invented zero.
prior_history_caveat: Original industry changes and unavailable older industry classification do not rewrite prior eight S innovations.
